# SmartSales

> SmartSales is a CRM, sales, marketing, and customer-support platform for businesses in Indonesia. It unifies WhatsApp Business API, email, and sales pipeline management in one multi-tenant, custom-buildable system, with a particular focus on closing the gap between marketing and sales teams so leads generated by campaigns don't get lost before a sales rep follows up.

SmartSales is built by Solvera and serves businesses across industries in Indonesia (FMCG, logistics, hospitality, finance, retail, IT/SaaS, outsourcing, tour & travel, and others). Primary language is Indonesian.

## Core solution

- [Integrasi Sales & Marketing](https://www.smartsales.id/solusi/integrasi-sales-marketing): The core problem SmartSales solves — leads generated by marketing campaigns (WhatsApp, email, web forms) going unfollowed by sales due to no shared system, no SLA, and no visibility between teams. Covers a 5-step framework (identify, standardize, automate, monitor, optimize) and how the product implements it.

## Products

- [CRM Sales](https://www.smartsales.id/produk/crm-sales): Visual sales pipeline, task automation, follow-up reminders, and analytics.
- [CRM Services](https://www.smartsales.id/produk/crm-services): Customer service ticketing with SLA tracking and quick replies.
- [Omnichannel](https://www.smartsales.id/produk/omnichannel): Unified inbox for WhatsApp, Instagram, and email.
- [Ticket Creation](https://www.smartsales.id/produk/ticket): Turns chat conversations into trackable task tickets.

## Industry solutions

- [Solusi per industri](https://www.smartsales.id/solusi/): FMCG, logistik, perhotelan, keuangan, ritel, IT & SaaS, outsourcing, tour & travel, and role-based solutions for sales, marketing, customer service, HR, and operations teams.

## Guides

- [Blog](https://www.smartsales.id/blog): Practical guides on lead management, sales-marketing integration, CRM migration, and related topics — written to be useful independent of the product, not just marketing copy.
